newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins dip on position-squaring.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins dip on position-squaring.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were overall quoted lower than late on Tuesday but dealers said prices were fluctuating both ways on apparent switching of positions between MinFins, Vnesh loans and U.S. Treasuries.
"Today's moves of MinFins were linked to Vnesh and Treasuries but it was not that they were following them, people were closing positions in one paper and opening in another," one dealer said.
A Bank Imperial dealer said some banks were selling MinFins as they did not expect a further rise in U.S. Treasuries.
MinFins, like other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news which would suggest a change in U.S. interest rates and consequently affect U.S. Treasury bond prices.
May U.S. retail sales and producer prices will be released on Thursday and Friday respectively, while Russian markets will be closed for the June 12 Independence Day holiday.
